local_guard_diagnosis.cause: The execution wrapper compared relative claim directory paths to the absolute current-plan directory. It counted the current claim as a prior claim and stopped before reading credentials.
local_guard_diagnosis.attribution: Execution wrapper error; no provider, model-output or credential-validity conclusion.
local_guard_diagnosis.verification: Read-only reproduction confirmed the mismatch; normalized comparison matches the reviewed prior inventory from both working directories.
local_guard_diagnosis.fix_scope: Local read-only checker only; no rerun of the consumed plan, no application source or prompt change.

budget_reconciliation.scope: Local conservative reservation, not actual provider spending. First-round second-request cost is still unknown.
